chunks: Muhammad ibn Musa ibn al-Mutawakkall (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us that Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar narrated to him from Ahmad ibn al-Ayes, raising it (to the Imam), from Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon them both) who said:
On the Day of Resurrection, we will intercede for the sinful ones among our Shia, but as for the righteous ones, Allah has already saved them.
ai.seo_question: Who does the Shia intercede for on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: This hadith from Fadail al-Shia highlights the unique role of the Ahl al-Bayt in interceding specifically for the 'sinful' among their followers, distinguishing them from the 'righteous' who are saved by Allah's direct grace. It underscores the Shia belief in the protective intercession (shafa'ah) of the Imams, offering hope to those who may have faltered in their faith but remain loyal to the Shi'a.
